summary: OpenAI announced plans to acquire Ona to expand Codex with secure, persistent cloud environments for running long-running AI agents in enterprise workflows.

mechanisms.reason: The acquisition is explicitly aimed at enabling long-running, persistent AI agents to operate across enterprise workflows, extending agent execution beyond simple API calls.
mechanisms.quote: OpenAI plans to acquire Ona to expand Codex with secure, persistent cloud environments, enabling long-running AI agents across enterprise workflows.

practices.reason: Adding persistent cloud environments to Codex will change how engineering teams provision and monitor agent runtimes, though no concrete migration details are given yet.
